objective: Implement the first useful Cozy Solo core loop in Personal context using APM-I01 delegation/run authority and ordinary owning-domain operations without changing mechanics or creating a second rules engine.
implementation_result: No migration 0013 was added because APM-I01 already durably stores mode/profile version, Personal context, selectors/capabilities, automatic-resolution classes, mandatory human-choice classes, step/event/resource bounds, AI policy, expiry/revocation, run lifecycle and recovery/status evidence.
Added a versioned CozyPreferenceProfile view bound to the APM-I01 grant/run rather than duplicate persistence authority.

Added a deterministic local-alpha/CI Cozy Solo orchestrator that filters to delegated focus, reauthorizes every state-affecting step, executes only owning-domain automatic classes, routes proposal-required work to governed approval, and stops before human/GM/prohibited boundaries.

Added one-step and bounded-batch pacing, zero real-money automation, AI-disabled/presentation-only boundary, operation-status lost-response recovery, feature-disable/manual fallback, and an Orient → Confirm bounds → Progress → Summary/Return-to-ordinary-play UI.
Twelve focused acceptance cases plus the full client suite passed on both self-hosted platforms; deterministic comparison passed.

completion_gate_result: PASS — Personal-context user can orient, confirm explicit bounds, execute one or bounded routine steps with fresh owning-domain authorization, stop deterministically at proposal/human/GM/prohibited/budget/authorization barriers, recover lost responses without duplicate execution, receive attributable summaries and return to ordinary play; AI/paid providers are unnecessary and real-money automation remains zero.
authority_boundary: APM-I02 never became mechanics, GM authority, consent authority, publication authority, a game-state ledger or a second rules engine. Owning domains remain authoritative for mechanics and Events.
